grammar.pattern: 介宾 / 方位 / 兼语 / 同位短语
grammar.explanation: 介宾: 跟朋友 / 在教室, preposition plus its object. 方位: 桌子上 / 教室里面, referent plus location word. 兼语: 请朋友介绍, where 朋友 is both the object of 请 and the subject of 介绍. 同位: 老师张先生, where two expressions identify the same person. Do not interpret apposition as two teachers or a pivot construction as two unrelated events.

examples.zh: 我跟朋友在教室里面见面。
examples.py: wǒ gēn péng you zài jiào shì lǐ miàn jiàn miàn .
examples.en: I meet my friend inside the classroom.

examples.py: qǐng péng you jiè shào tā de cháng chù .
examples.en: Ask the friend to introduce her strengths.

examples.py: lǎo shī zhāng xiān shēng yě lái le .

commonMistakes.right: 老师张先生指同一个人。
commonMistakes.why: The two appositive expressions refer to the same person.

grammar.pattern: 大主语 + 小主语 + 谓语
grammar.purpose: Read the larger topic and its internal statement
grammar.explanation: A subject–predicate phrase can itself be the predicate: 她汉语说得很流利. 她 is the larger subject; 汉语说得很流利 says something about her Chinese. Similarly 这篇文章内容很清楚 has 这篇文章 as the larger subject and 内容很清楚 as its predicate. This is not a request to add a comma or 是 between every pair of nouns.

examples.py: tā hàn yǔ shuō de hěn liú lì .
zhè piān wén zhāng nèi róng hěn qīng chǔ .

examples.zh: 他组织活动的本领很强。
examples.py: tā zǔ zhī huó dòng de běn lǐng hěn qiáng .
examples.en: His ability to organize events is strong.

commonMistakes.why: Do not add 是 to this ordinary subject–predicate construction.

dialogue.blurb: An original scene written for this course.

lines.zh: 你说的那个朋友，是我们初中同学小周吗？
lines.py: nǐ shuō de nà gè péng you , shì wǒ men chū zhōng tóng xué xiǎo zhōu ma ?
lines.en: Is the friend you mentioned Xiao Zhou, our classmate from junior secondary school?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，她最近写了一篇旅行的文章。
lines.py: duì , tā zuì jìn xiě le yī piān lǚ xíng de wén zhāng .
lines.en: Yes. She recently wrote an article about a trip.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我看过！里面那张窗边的照片，也是她拍的？
lines.py: wǒ kàn guò ! lǐ miàn nà zhāng chuāng biān de zhào piān , yě shì tā pāi de ?
lines.en: I've read it! Did she take the photo beside the window too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是。她文字写得好，照片也拍得好。
lines.py: shì . tā wén zì xiě de hǎo , zhào piān yě pāi de hǎo .
lines.en: Yes. She writes well and takes good photos too.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 真有本事。我写到一半就不知道写什么了。
lines.py: zhēn yǒu běn shì . wǒ xiě dào yí bàn jiù bù zhī dào xiě shén me le .
lines.en: She's talented. I never know what to write halfway through.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你不是没有事情写，是一开始就想把整年都写完。
lines.py: nǐ bù shì méi yǒu shì qíng xiě , shì yī kāi shǐ jiù xiǎng bǎ zhěng nián dōu xiě wán .
lines.en: You have things to write about. You just try to fit the whole year in from the start.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我只写上次去看表演？
lines.py: nà wǒ zhǐ xiě shàng cì qù kàn biǎo yǎn ?
lines.en: Should I just write about seeing that performance?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 可以。先写门口等人的那一段，我读着就想笑。
lines.py: kě yǐ . xiān xiě mén kǒu děng rén de nà yī duàn , wǒ dú zhe jiù xiǎng xiào .
lines.en: Yes. Start with waiting for people at the entrance. That makes me smile when I read it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我能不能请小周帮我看一下？
lines.py: wǒ néng bù néng qǐng xiǎo zhōu bāng wǒ kàn yī xià ?
lines.en: Could I ask Xiao Zhou to take a look?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我问问她。她这周在赶文章，周末可能有空。
lines.py: wǒ wèn wèn tā . tā zhè zhōu zài gǎn wén zhāng , zhōu mò kě néng yǒu kōng .
lines.en: I'll ask. She's finishing an article this week and may be free at the weekend.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，我先把那一段写好，别空着手请人家改。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ xiān bǎ nà yī duàn xiě hǎo , bié kōng zhuó shǒu qǐng rén jiā gǎi .
lines.en: Good. I'll finish that passage first rather than ask her to revise a blank page.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 写完发给我，我也想看你怎么写那天。
lines.py: xiě wán fā gěi wǒ , wǒ yě xiǎng kàn nǐ zěn me xiě nà tiān .
lines.en: Send it when it's done. I'd like to see your version of that day too.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A description with a basis
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 陈宇提起小周，我才想起她是我们初中同学。上次见她时，我们都还在准备考试，现在她已经会给杂志写文章了。
lines.py: chén yǔ tí qǐ xiǎo zhōu , wǒ cái xiǎng qǐ tā shì wǒ men chū zhōng tóng xué . shàng cì jiàn tā shí , wǒ men dōu hái zài zhǔn bèi kǎo shì , xiàn zài tā yǐ jīng huì gěi zá zhì xiě wén zhāng le .
lines.en: When Chen Yu mentioned Xiao Zhou, I remembered our junior secondary school classmate. Last time we met we were preparing for exams; now she writes for magazines.

lines.zh: 我读了她写的旅行故事。文章里没有把每一天都列出来，只写在一座小城住的三个晚上。房东的猫每天来窗边，她就从那只猫开始写。
lines.py: wǒ dú le tā xiě de lǚ xíng gù shì . wén zhāng lǐ méi yǒu bǎ měi yī tiān dōu liè chū lái , zhǐ xiě zài yī zuò xiǎo chéng zhù de sān gè wǎn shang . fáng dōng de māo měi tiān lái chuāng biān , tā jiù cóng nà zhǐ māo kāi shǐ xiě .
lines.en: I read her travel story. It did not list every day, just three nights in a small town. The landlord's cat came to the window daily, and that was where she began.

lines.zh: 我原来想把一年的事情都放进自己的文章，写到一半就停了。陈宇让我先写一个晚上，我选了上次和朋友去看表演的那天。
lines.py: wǒ yuán lái xiǎng bǎ yī nián de shì qíng dōu fàng jìn zì jǐ de wén zhāng , xiě dào yí bàn jiù tíng le . chén yǔ ràng wǒ xiān xiě yī gè wǎn shang , wǒ xuǎn le shàng cì hé péng you qù kàn biǎo yǎn de nà tiān .
lines.en: I had tried to put a whole year in my own article and stopped halfway. Chen Yu suggested one evening. I chose the night we went to a performance with friends.

lines.zh: 最开始我只写大家很高兴，读起来却没有什么画面。后来写到陈宇在门口找票、朋友从包里拿出三张票，我自己读着都笑了。
lines.py: zuì kāi shǐ wǒ zhǐ xiě dà jiā hěn gāo xìng , dú qǐ lái què méi yǒu shén me huà miàn . hòu lái xiě dào chén yǔ zài mén kǒu zhǎo piào , péng you cóng bāo lǐ ná chū sān zhāng piào , wǒ zì jǐ dú zhe dōu xiào le .
lines.en: At first I only wrote that everyone was happy, which gave little to picture. Later I described Chen Yu searching for his ticket while a friend took three out of her bag. I smiled reading it myself.

lines.zh: 周末，小周看了那一段，问票为什么在朋友包里。我才发现忘了写买票的事，赶紧加上前面的两句。她没有替我全部重写，只指出读者可能会问的地方。
lines.py: zhōu mò , xiǎo zhōu kàn le nà yī duàn , wèn piào wèi shén me zài péng you bāo lǐ . wǒ cái fā xiàn wàng le xiě mǎi piào de shì , gǎn jǐn jiā shàng qián miàn de liǎng jù . tā méi yǒu tì wǒ quán bù zhòng xiě , zhǐ zhǐ chū dú zhě kě néng huì wèn de dì fāng .
lines.en: At the weekend Xiao Zhou read it and asked why the tickets were in the friend's bag. I had left out buying them, so I added two earlier sentences. She did not rewrite everything; she pointed out where a reader might ask a question.

lines.zh: 我把改好的文章发给陈宇。他说这回能看见那天的样子了，还问能不能把最后一句留给他。那句写着，你下次先看看是谁买票，再找自己的口袋。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ gǎi hǎo de wén zhāng fā gěi chén yǔ . tā shuō zhè huí néng kàn jiàn nà tiān de yàng zi le , hái wèn néng bù néng bǎ zuì hòu yī jù liú gěi tā . nà jù xiě zhe , nǐ xià cì xiān kàn kàn shì shéi mǎi piào , zài zhǎo zì jǐ de kǒu dài .
lines.en: I sent the revised article to Chen Yu. He said he could picture that evening now and asked to keep the last line for himself: next time, check who bought the tickets before searching your pockets.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三32, 三53. Native check: 本领 versus 本事 register, apposition 老师张先生, larger-topic scope in 主谓谓语句, 职业 disclosure, 表面 impressions versus evidence, and 作品评价 phrasing. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三26 / 三72 / 三30 / 三70: 为了带书方便，我选这个布袋。, 为了纪念见面，我们做一张贺卡。, 要是时间合适，就再问她。, 只有她同意，才写她的职业。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Earlier HSK 3 naturalness correction: a classmate helps with a small article, friends choose a rainy-day film venue, a photo makes a bridge look close, and two adults start swimming lessons. Removed identity/privacy/assessment cautions and report-like conversation. All target words have independently authored contexts instead of being stuffed into speech. Formed six text questions and nine or ten mixed tasks from the actual new facts while keeping all old IDs. Native flags: colloquial teasing about tickets and photos; 大主语/小主语 description; 好是好，就是; time-from 起 and elapsed 了; 精神 jīngshén as spirit versus the earlier energetic jīngshen; 录 as a bound verb in 录入; realistic descriptions of a first swimming class. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
